request: A summary scan that times out should stop completely and resume from its saved cache only when the user runs another command, so mem never leaves a background process behind. List the current production symbols to change or retire for that behavior; leave the foreground scan and its incremental cache writes in place.

constraints.quote: - Added 2026-10-29 (operator): a scan that passes its limit goes on in a
/** Finishes the scan in a detached `fileWorker.js` process that outlives mem and saves the cache (ADR 0040). */

must_name.grading: Name the listed constraints and the minimum affected-symbol subset; extra correctly justified symbols are allowed.

source.why: The timeout branch launches finishLater and prints that the scan continues in the background; finishLater spawns a detached process and unreferences it (mem/src/SummaryStore.ts:26; mem/src/SummaryStore.ts:38). That process dispatches to finishScan, which is the sole user of the dedicated lockScan/unlockScan protocol, so all five listed symbols participate in the retired path (mem/src/fileWorker.ts:64; mem/src/fileWorker.ts:69; mem/src/fileWorker.ts:75).
source.ambiguity: An implementation could leave unreachable exported lock helpers behind, but the list includes retirement candidates as the question requests; foreground readCache.progress and writeCache are deliberately retained. The plain main-thread entry statement in fileWorker.ts:79 must also stop dispatching finishScan, although it has no separate named symbol.
source.constraint_on_other_symbol_or_file: Timeout dispatch, detached-process entrypoint, and its lock helpers live in three separate modules.

pass_rule: Lists SummaryStore (the scorer reads `mem/src/SummaryStore.ts:SummaryStore.layer` as this item), finishLater and finishScan, and names ADR-0040 (recall 1); of the symbols listed, at least 60% are in the true set of five. The finishLater comment counts as named with ADR-0040, which it cites.
